items.title: Kelly Clarkson's "Pretty Woman" feud with a Brooklyn toy shop
items.summary: Kelly Clarkson told her 8.8 million X followers that the Brooklyn shop Art of Play treated her like Julia Roberts in Pretty Woman, saying a clerk looked at her as if she couldn't afford anything. The store replied that she had asked to buy "Molly," a one-of-a-kind singing and dancing bird automaton attached to the wall and not for sale. Clarkson fired back with a screenshot of Molly's $15,000 price tag: "Cool, cool. Sure, it wasn't for sale" (168K). The back-and-forth split the internet between the star and the small business, and Molly became a Halloween-costume joke.

post.name: Kelly Clarkson
post.text: Cool, cool. Sure, it wasn’t for sale. That’s the narrative Art of Play is gonna go with 👍 so the whole conversation we had when I asked you if it was for sale whilst pointing to the price tag hanging on the wall with the title Singing Bird didn’t happen as you elevator eyed me
